fusions.name: Devour the Penned
fusions.desc: Uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 16 damage, 60% more for each one eaten. It is left 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Baited Hook
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. A baited hook deals 9 damage and heals you for 30% of it, with a 25% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Dinner Bell
fusions.desc: Increases the healing you receive by 30% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Stocked Larder
fusions.desc: Every kill you make builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you heal for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
